verdict: REJECTED AND REVERTED. The parity gate did its job.
what_was_attempted: Collapse the MoE layer to one command buffer: move silu_mul to device, encode gate/up/silu/down into a single TokenCommandBuffer. Static target 234 -> 78 synchronizations per token.

why_it_was_rejected.detail: The device silu diverges from the host at the last 1-2 ULP -- 0.0026828013 against 0.002682801. The formulas are algebraically identical, (g / (1 + exp(-g))) * u on both sides. The divergence is Metal's exp against libm's exp.
why_it_was_rejected.attempted_fix: Switching the shader to precise::exp did NOT close it. Metal's precise transcendentals still differ from libm in the last bit.

why_it_was_rejected.detail: That test passed 3/3 before this merge. The lane's 300 lines in gravity_glm_resident.rs altered the NON-collapsed resident path it was contracted to leave alone, behind an additive flag. Reverting the merge restored it to 3/3 immediately, which confirms the cause.
why_it_was_rejected.severity: This is worse than the ULP issue. A flagged, additive change silently changed a default path whose parity had already been established and merged.

controller_error_recorded: I changed the shader from exp to precise::exp while diagnosing, believing the resident path was unaffected. It uses the same kernel, so I perturbed a passing path mid-diagnosis. Reverted. Diagnosing a failure by editing shared code is how a second bug gets attributed to the first.

the_real_question_this_raises.issue: Bit-identical logits between a CPU reference and a GPU kernel may be unattainable wherever a transcendental is involved. exp, and therefore silu, sigmoid and softmax, are the obvious cases.
the_real_question_this_raises.why_it_matters_beyond_this_lane: Every future device-side kernel that replaces host math will hit this. The Temporal Gravity ladder requires moving attention, routing, the head and sampling to device -- softmax and exp appear in most of them.
options: Keep bit-identical LOGITS as the gate and implement libm-exact expf in Metal. Heavy, fragile, but preserves the strongest contract.

Move the gate to bit-identical EMITTED TOKENS over a large prompt set, with logit divergence bounded and reported. The campaign's own wording allows this -- 'exact output parity OR the frozen quality contract' -- and output tokens are what the artifact actually promises.
Keep the host as the reference for transcendental steps only, accepting the readback cost there and collapsing everywhere else.
the_real_question_this_raises.recommendation: Option 2, but it is a CONTRACT CHANGE and belongs to the user, not to a lane under deadline. Until it is decided, bit-identical logits remains the gate and this lane stays rejected. Choosing the weaker contract in the middle of a failing test is exactly how a quality gate erodes.

what_survives: GPU-resident state remains merged, parity-green at 3/3, and measured at exactly 1.00x. The collapse it was meant to enable has not been achieved.
not_evidence_of: that the collapse is impossible -- only that this implementation broke a passing path and could not hold bit-identity
